scope: H2 79 prior replay-only memberships ONLY; research, unaccepted until independently reviewed

rules.UNIQUE_EXACT_ORIGINAL_ALERT_START: Original ISO8601 time with an explicit UTC offset equals the start of exactly one episode in the pinned original chronological Git slices, and that episode is the original accepted target; Europe/Kyiv default is NOT sufficient.
rules.UNIQUE_CONTAINMENT_ALL_EXPLICIT_EVENT_TI: All full ISO8601 explicit-offset event instants from the ORIGINAL source fall inside exactly one and the same independently preserved canonical interval, which is the original target episode.
rules.SOURCE_SPECIFIC_TIMEZONE_CONTRACT_MISSIN: Original source-local naive timestamp has no independently accepted per-source timezone or offset. Worker default Europe/Kyiv is not per-source authority; no conversion is presumed.
rules.EXACT_UNIQUE_ORIGINAL_EVENT_OR_ALERT_CLO: Source describes approximate, partial, or naive time without independently sufficient exact unique source/episode pairing.
rules.SPLIT_EVENT_CLOCK_REQUIRES_UNPROVEN_HIST: Two source link identities share one original Git record; partition into two separately timed children depends on a historical interpretation not in the immutable original observation.
rules.EXPLICIT_CLOCK_NOT_EQUAL_TO_CANONICAL_AL: Original explicit-offset episode clock does not equal the accepted canonical alert start; without an independent binding do not coerce, overwrite, or claim contradiction.
